reasoning: A bare upward arrow is generic UI chrome (scroll up, sort ascending, high priority, shift key) rather than a concrete task subject. While it can loosely suggest uploading or increasing something, almost every real task has a specific central noun (money, file, server, box) that makes a far better icon.
